title: Whale dream
content: I’ve been going crazy the last 2 years over this dream I keep having. It starts with me climbing a set of metal stairs that are a little wet and it’s a climb, once you get to the top, there’s a flat platform like on a regular water tank, you can walk around it and there’s always other people there. You look into this deep water tank that you’ve climbed (but it’s like an exhibit if that makes sense) and you see a whale one singular whale and it’s alone and never makes a noise never comes to the surface but I know there’s a whale in there. I have tried for 2 years to find places that look similar or give me any inkling of familiarity and nothing so far. Maybe someone here has had similar dreams? Thanks!🥰 (example of water tower set it I’m talking about, not exact but you get the gist)
